summary: CTW Cayman filed a Form 6-K reporting resolutions adopted at its annual general meeting on May 7, 2026. Shareholders approved a corporate name change to CTW, an amendment and restatement of the memorandum and articles of association, and related actions. The name change became effective upon shareholder approval, with Class A ordinary shares expected to begin trading under the new name on Nasdaq around May 13, 2026, under the same ticker symbol CTW and CUSIP number. No special-situation transaction such as an acquisition, divestiture, or tender offer is involved. This is a routine corporate governance update.
